newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales off 0.5 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales off 0.5 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales fell 0.5 percent in the week ended November 23 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 3.7 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was unchanged from the prior month.

"Sales were generally on-to-above plan for most retailers and once again the weakness that did exist was generally expected due to the shifting of calendars and promotional activity," a BTM/Schroder report said.
